title: BSPvPToggleEN
description: A lightweight PvP toggle plugin providing per-player PvP control and enforcement. Compatible with Spigot, Paper, Folia, and Purpur. Supports Minecraft 1.20–1.21.9.
body:
**BSPvPToggleEN**

A lightweight PvP toggle plugin providing per-player PvP control and enforcement. Compatible with Spigot, Paper, Folia, and Purpur. Supports Minecraft 1.20–1.21.9.

**Compatibility**

- Server types: Spigot, Paper, **_Folia_**, Purpur
- Game versions: 1.20–1.21.9
- Build target: Java 17 (runs fine on Java 21 servers)

**Features**

- Toggle personal PvP with `/pvp on` and `/pvp off`
- Check current PvP status with `/pvp status`
- PvP damage between players is only allowed when both have PvP enabled
- If either player has PvP disabled, the damage is blocked and both players receive feedback
- Folia compatible: runtime detection and thread-safe task/message dispatching
- Persistence: player PvP states stored in YAML and retained across restarts

![Pvp status](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d637952048f7757c0f4ac2287b2873c0278a2a84.png)

![/pvp on and /pvp off](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/88849b954af747d04d9cfaef33791fd65550f561.png)

![Both players must have PvP enabled in order to attack each other](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/24ce804be19ba44f405ee71ea274432d6d8d5a73.png)

**Commands**

- `/pvp on`: Enable personal PvP
- `/pvp off`: Disable personal PvP
- `/pvp status`: Show current personal PvP status

**Permissions**

- `bspvptoggle.use`: Allow using `/pvp` commands
- `bspvptoggle.admin`: Reserved for future admin features (optional in current version)
